sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Fedrigoni is a materials company offering a wide range of specialty papers, technical cards, and self-adhesive materials with 10 brands and 25,000 product references across multiple industries.

Industry: Materials & Specialty Papers · HQ: Verona, Italy · Size: $250M-$1B · Products: Specialty Cards, Technical Cards, Personalized Solutions, Self-Adhesive Labels, Visual Communication, Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Fedrigoni scores 12 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by company size (12/15). Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: ORAFOL Europe (15% similar on self-adhesive, films, wide, materials); Mactac (11% similar on films, specialty, labels, media); Drytac (9% similar on films, self-adhesive, media, life). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
